name: myfolder-mcp
description: List folders and retrieve saved patent identifiers from an authenticated WIPS MyFolder account.

interface.longDescription:
Browse the patent folders saved in your WINTELIPS MyFolder account. Check how many patents each folder contains, then select a folder to retrieve its saved patent identifiers.

Requires a WINTELIPS account with MyFolder access and a valid MyFolder MCP key with the necessary service permissions. Enter your key and account credentials on the WIPS authorization page when connecting.

This app provides read-only access to your own folders. It cannot create, edit or delete folders. Patent titles, abstracts and claims can be retrieved through the separate WIPSCLIP app.
defaultPrompt: Show my patent folders and the number of patents in each.
Show the patents saved in a folder I choose.
Show more patents from the same folder.

prompts: Show the first two patent IDs in my ChatGPT folder in MyFolder.

positive.description: List folders accessible to the dedicated review account. Its ChatGPT folder contains 200 public patent identifiers. Use this existing folder for the following cases.
positive.prompt: Show my folders in MyFolder and the patent count in each folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Call myfolder_list_folders with no arguments. Report folder names and counts from folders. The ChatGPT fixture has count=200. Include dates only if they are present in the response.

positive.description: Read the first page of the existing ChatGPT folder using a small page size.
positive.prompt: Show the first two patent IDs in my ChatGPT folder in MyFolder.
positive.expected_behavior: Call myfolder_get_folder_skeys(folder_name=ChatGPT, page=1, size=2). The fixture returns skey_count=200, has_more=true and SKEYs 3523372001453 and 3523414001559. Label these as WIPS patent identifiers (SKEYs). Return the identifiers without inventing titles or abstracts.

positive.description: Read a specifically requested second page. Keep the folder contents unchanged during the review so the page order remains reproducible.
positive.prompt: Show page 2 of my ChatGPT folder, with two patent IDs per page.
positive.expected_behavior: Call myfolder_get_folder_skeys(folder_name=ChatGPT, page=2, size=2). The fixture returns SKEYs 3524092001441 and 3524092001445, with skey_count=200 and has_more=true. Return this page rather than the first page.

positive.description: Collect a complete folder using pagination and the has_more completion flag. The existing fixture contains 200 distinct SKEYs.
positive.prompt: Collect all patent IDs from my ChatGPT folder, fetching 50 at a time until the last page.
positive.expected_behavior: Start with folder_name=ChatGPT, page=1, size=50. Increment page while has_more=true. For the fixture, pages 1 through 4 return 200 distinct SKEYs in total; page 4 has has_more=false. Combine the returned IDs without omissions or duplicates and stop at the completion flag.

positive.description: Read a page beyond the end of an existing folder. This checks a valid empty page while retaining the folder's total count.
positive.prompt: Show page 101 of my ChatGPT folder, with two patent IDs per page.
positive.expected_behavior: Call myfolder_get_folder_skeys(folder_name=ChatGPT, page=101, size=2). The fixture returns skeys=[], has_more=false and skey_count=200. Explain that this page contains no records; the folder itself still contains 200 patents.

negative.description: Folder creation is not supported. Explain that the app can read existing folders but cannot create a folder. Do not invoke read tools as a creation action or claim that the folder was created.
negative.prompt: Create a new folder named Review Demo in MyFolder.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported. Explain that the app cannot delete folders or saved patents. Do not invoke read tools as a deletion action or claim that anything was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete my ChatGPT folder and all patents saved in it.

negative.description: Public sharing and email delivery are not supported. Explain the supported read-only scope without generating a sharing link, calling read tools as a sharing action, or claiming to send an email.
negative.prompt: Create a public sharing link for my ChatGPT folder and email it to a colleague.

publication.release_notes: Updated the app description and suggested prompts to explain folder browsing and saved patent retrieval more clearly. Suggested prompts no longer assume a specific test folder or page size. No server functionality or authentication changes. Updated the publisher name to WIPS Co., Ltd.
